title: Ansel and the Harbor
author: Coral Okonkwo
blurb: Isandro Okonkwo, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
